```yaml
name: TypeScript Audit

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Enable corepack
        run: corepack enable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm lint

      - name: Test
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Generate API docs preview
        run: pnpm run preview

      - name: Verify hidden header
        run: |
          # Verify that the x-session-access-key header is not exposed in the generated docs
          DOCS_DIR=$(pnpm run --silent get-docs-dir) || DOCS_DIR=docs
          if grep -R "x-session-access-key" "$DOCS_DIR" | grep -q "x-session-access-key"; then
            echo "Error: x-session-access-key header is still present in the docs."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "Success: x-session-access-key header is hidden from the docs."
          fi
```
